headline: DPR Approves NTB-NTT Issuing Regional Bonds, Here Are the Requirements
summary: Indonesia's House of Representatives approved plans for the NTB and NTT provinces to issue regional bonds. The approval is subject to specified conditions.
why: Regional government bonds fund local infrastructure and tourism projects and add to the domestic fixed-income market.
original_headline: DPR Restui NTB-NTT Terbitkan Obligasi Daerah, Ini Syaratnya
